Sections.Name: Enemy Loot
Sections.Description: Controls physical presentation of corpse inventories.

Keys.Name: Physical Enemy Drops
Keys.Description: Show enabled enemy categories in the world. Corpse contents remain unchanged.

Keys.Name: Impulse Strength
Keys.Description: Enemy launch strength in percent. 200 is the default and slider midpoint (the previous maximum); 400 doubles that launch velocity. 0 adds no launch velocity (items still fall). Does not affect player throws.

Sections.Name: Enemy Categories
Sections.Description: Disabled categories remain lootable in the corpse. Applies to tracked corpses and future deaths. Enchanted equipment and quest-tagged items follow their base category.

Keys.Name: Placement Mode Key
Keys.Description: While holding an item, toggle billboard/fixed placement. Enter a Unity KeyCode name such as P, F10, or Keypad5.

Keys.Name: Freeze Placement Key
Keys.Description: Freeze a held or targeted item in place without changing billboard/flat mode. Hold Activate to adjust it; release leaves it frozen at the new position. Tap Activate to pick it up directly, even while frozen. Press the freeze key again to restore physics. Enter a Unity KeyCode name.

Keys.Name: Scroll Mode Key
Keys.Description: While holding an item, press to toggle the scroll wheel between Scaling and Rotating, with HUD feedback. Rotation tilts the sprite by normally 3 degrees per notch without changing billboard/flat mode. The chosen scroll mode is remembered between grabs and stored with your save. Enter a Unity KeyCode name; either Ctrl key works when set to LeftControl or RightControl.

Keys.Name: Character Item Collision
Keys.Description: Players and enemies push loose items sideways along the ground instead of stepping onto them. Movement speed determines push strength. Items are not character platforms; frozen, pinned and held items are not pushed. Off by default.
